trust_decision.summary: MISMATCH: the advisory covers ReDoS from untrusted WS subscription path/context globs compiled into regexes in src/subscriptionmanager.ts, but the linked fix commit decides whether a client IP may still attempt a WS login (shared login rate limiter) in src/interfaces/ws.ts processLoginRequest; the fix does not touch the regex code at all.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names WebSocket subscription paths and ReDoS; pathMatcher turns the subscribe path glob into a '.*' regex. The fix commit's actual site (src/interfaces/ws.ts:727) would not be found from the summary.
